summary:
Iteration 10 (Phase 8/9/11) — ALL review items pass. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing (test_iter10_scanner_editor.py). Scanner /api/scanner/process on a synthetic dark-bg + bright quadrilateral image → 200, found_document=True, image_base64 returned (~700-byte JPEG); mode 'bw' also returns 200 with image_base64. /api/scanner/create-pdf with 2 processed pages → download_id + pages=2; GET /api/downloads includes the new item with kind='scan'; GET /api/downloads/{id}/file?token=JWT returns %PDF (Content-Type application/pdf). Editor: POST /api/editor/save 3× on same doc id (different html each time) then GET /api/editor/{id}/versions returns >=2 version entries each with ts/by/html and title populated. POST /api/editor/export-pdf with page_setup {margins:'narrow', header:'My Header', footer:'Confidential', page_numbers:true} + html '

Title

Hello world

' returns a valid PDF whose extracted text via pymupdf contains 'My Header', 'Confidential', 'Hello world' AND 'Page 1'. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, alice@bachein.com): (1) Home drawer contains all 3 new items drawer-downloads, drawer-drafts, drawer-scanner — tapping drawer-downloads navigates to /downloads (downloads-screen renders with existing seeded items). (2) /downloads ⋯ menu now shows dl-action-open, dl-action-share, dl-action-rename, dl-action-delete; tapping dl-action-open navigates to /viewer with viewer-screen visible and an iframe embedding the authed PDF URL. (3) /drafts shows draft rows with draft-history-{id}, opening history sheet shows 2 versions for TEST iter10 doc — tapping version-0 → preview → version-restore button visible. (4) /editor picker opens, start-editor-btn → editor-screen with tools-btn in header; tools-btn opens Document tools sheet showing tool-find-replace, tool-page-setup, tool-proofread + 4 font-size chips (S/M/L/XL). Find & Replace opens with find-input/replace-input/replace-all-btn — tapping replace-all-btn correctly emits a '"world" not found' toast (proves the underlying HTML search ran). Page setup shows margin-narrow/normal/wide chips + page-numbers-toggle + page-setup-done — tapping page-setup-done emits 'Page setup will be applied on PDF export ✓' toast. (5) /scanner renders scanner-screen with camera-permission gate (scanner-grant button visible — browser has no camera as expected). (6) AI /chat renders the new BacheinAiLogo (b + pencil image) with 0 broken images and no JS console errors. RichEditor content body still shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' on web preview — carried-over known limitation (see iter9), not a bug.

react_native_issues.issue: On the Expo web preview, react-native-pell-rich-editor still shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' inside the editor body — well-known react-native-webview web limitation. Tools modals + Find/Replace + Page setup + tools-btn all work correctly. Non-blocking; native mobile is unaffected. Reference: /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx (RichEditor mount).

action_items: No blocking fixes needed — all 10 review items pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py scanner_process: cleanly falls back to full-frame image if no 4-point contour is found (found_document=False) — good UX; bw path uses adaptiveThreshold + CLAHE for color path, both wrapped in try/except so a bad frame will not 500. Result JPEG quality=82 is a sensible default.
server.py scanner_create_pdf caps at 30 pages and uses fitz page-per-image; skipping bad pages silently is fine but could log for observability.

server.py editor_save pushes previous html snapshot (truncated to 200k chars) into versions[] on every subsequent save — versions list therefore grows one entry per save; GET /editor/{id}/versions returns the last 30 reversed (newest-first). Matches the /drafts UX.

server.py editor_export_pdf: reportlab-based print layout is clean — margins narrow(1.27cm)/normal(2.54cm)/wide(3.81cm), header centered with underline, footer left-aligned, right-aligned page number, bachein watermark at bottom. Header/footer strings truncated to safe lengths (110/80). PDF header 'My Header' + footer 'Confidential' + body 'Hello world' + 'Page 1' all present in the emitted PDF (verified via pymupdf).

downloads_routes.py list projects out pdf_b64 to keep the listing lightweight — /downloads/{id}/file returns the full bytes with a safe filename slug. Token-in-query supported via get_user_flex for browser downloads. Good separation.
frontend/app/viewer.tsx uses React.createElement('iframe') on web and Google Docs viewer wrapper on Android — sensible platform split.

frontend/app/editor.tsx tools sheet correctly wraps every interactive item with testID (tools-btn, tool-find-replace, tool-page-setup, tool-proofread, font-size-{S/M/L/XL}, find-input, replace-input, replace-all-btn, margin-{narrow/normal/wide}, page-numbers-toggle, page-setup-done). Easy to automate.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_scanner_editor.py (NEW — 8 tests covering scanner process/create-pdf/downloads/file, editor versions, export-pdf with page_setup)

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest — scanner process color+bw, scanner create-pdf 2-page, downloads listing contains scan, downloads file returns %PDF, cleanup, editor save 3x + versions >=2 with ts/by/html, editor export-pdf w/ page_setup renders header+footer+page-number+body)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 review items — drawer 3 new items, drawer-downloads nav, downloads ⋯ menu 4 actions incl dl-action-open, viewer iframe on web, drafts + history sheet + version preview + version-restore, editor tools-btn + tools sheet + find/replace + page setup + font size chips, scanner screen w/ camera-permission gate, AI chat new logo no broken images no console errors)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 scan download (deleted at end of scanner test class), 1 editor doc 'TEST iter10 doc' with 2 version snapshots (retained for /drafts history verification), 1 transient export-pdf response. All test data prefixed 'TEST' for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 backend test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_scanner_editor.py — uses cv2+numpy to synthesise a scannable document (dark bg + bright quad) and verifies /api/scanner/process, /scanner/create-pdf, /downloads listing/file with query-token, editor version snapshots, and export-pdf page_setup (margins/header/footer/page_numbers) with pymupdf text assertion. Editor doc 'TEST iter10 doc' persists in alice's drafts (id in db); safe to reuse or /editor/save again — versions[] just keeps growing (capped at last 30 on GET). Frontend testIDs newly added: drawer-downloads / drawer-drafts / drawer-scanner (home drawer); downloads-screen, dl-action-open, dl-action-share, dl-action-rename, dl-action-delete, dl-rename-input, dl-rename-save; viewer-screen, viewer-back, viewer-share; drafts-screen, drafts-back, drafts-new, draft-{id}, draft-history-{id}, version-{i}, version-restore; scanner-screen, scanner-back, scanner-grant, scanner-settings, scan-capture, scan-mode, scan-retake, scan-add-page, scan-done, scan-finish, scan-name-input, scan-save; editor tools-btn, tool-find-replace, tool-page-setup, tool-proofread, font-size-S/M/L/XL, find-input, replace-input, replace-all-btn, margin-narrow/normal/wide, page-numbers-toggle, page-setup-done. RichEditor body stays 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' on web — verify tools via toasts (e.g. 'Page setup will be applied on PDF export ✓', '"<query>" not found' when find-replace has no matches) instead of introspecting editor HTML.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. All Phase 8/9/11 scanner + editor page-setup + drafts + drawer additions + viewer iframe work end-to-end on both backend and frontend.
